rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone thoughtfully considers other people's needs.

example.english: It was really thoughtful of you to wait with me for the bus so late.
example.traditional: 你咁夜仲陪我等車，真係好體貼。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 je6 zung6 pui4 ngo5 dang2 ce1 zan1 hai6 hou2 tai2 tip3

rows.note: Use this for a thoughtful effort or gesture, stressing that someone put real thought into it.

example.english: It was really thoughtful of you to make this box of cookies for me.
example.traditional: 你特登整呢盒曲奇畀我，真係好有心。
example.jyutping: nei5 dak6 dang1 zing2 ne1 hap2 kuk1 kei4 bei2 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 sam1

rows.note: Use this when thoughtful means careful and attentive rather than kind to someone.

example.english: They are thoughtful in their work and even spotted every typo in the document.
example.traditional: 佢做嘢好細心，連份文件入面嘅錯字都搵到。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 sai3 sam1 lin4 fan6 man4 gin6 jap6 min6 ge3 co3 zi6 dou1 wan2 dou2
